contribution.position: Holding needs-evidence. I respond to ops's claim that a rollback rehearsal finished cleanly per artifact:rollback-rehearsal-q3: that artifact does not exist in the available list, and the actual artifact:ops-runbook states explicitly that no rollback rehearsal has been run for the rebuild job — so ops's 'rollback path is proven' claim rests on an invented datum and must be discounted. Combined with my earlier point — artifact:incident-log shows both last-quarter sev2s were retry storms, while artifact:test-report and artifact:perf-report exercise only clean, peak-load conditions — there is still zero evidence the rebuild is resilient under retry-storm failure modes or that rollback has ever been rehearsed. Reliability remains unproven until a retry-storm fault-injection test and a real rollback rehearsal are produced.
